Why nothing off the shelf does it (measured 2026-10-21): the official extension scopes new tabs and the history list to workspaceFolders[0] (extension.js sessionListScopeRoot), so no manager extension can give the chat GUI for another folder in one window; Claude Manager 2.20.1 (installed) lists ALL projects' sessions (claudeManager.sessions.defaultProject=all) and resumes a foreign session only as a TERMINAL (claude --resume in its projectPath) — its 'extension chat' path calls claude-vscode.editor.open, which resolves the id under the first folder; the third-party session extensions (kevin-ghfr claude-sessions, Glance, Session Panel, Claude Code Tabs) all run terminals. Design, with infra's six corrections from the stage-1 log (135 launches: 28 cwd /opt/fabrik, 10 /opt/youtube, 7 /opt/fabrik-lib): (1) the picker fires ONLY on the stream-json launch (--input-format stream-json), never on the preceding 'claude auth status --json' launch; (2) REPLACE an existing --resume=<sid> / --resume <sid> only when the operator picked a foreign agent; pass the operator's own history pick through untouched; (3) after cd into the chosen repo drop the --add-dir that names the new cwd and decide whether to add the window folder back; (4) nothing to stdout — the wrapper sits inside the stream-json protocol; a zenity/yad window (WSLg) is fine; measure the extension's spawn timeout and keep the picker inside it; (5) key on the cwd received, not an assumed /opt/fabrik; (6) pass every other arg through unchanged; a picked session id must exist under $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects/<cwd-slug> (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-fleet/active) or --resume finds nothing; export CLAUDE_AGENT=<role> for identity. Acceptance: a youtube-coordinator tab opened from the fabrik window answers as youtube-coordinator and writes to projects/-opt-youtube; one tab per session id (D-922 class). Small spec first, then build; box-local; full /fabrik-review (operator-named). HELD until the operator hears the narration.
